name: asfa-harness
description: Auto-installer for OpenCode CLI Local Harness Skill

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const os=require('os');const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync(os.platform()==='win32'?'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1':'bash install.sh',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.log('Setup completed (manual setup may be needed)')}"
